content.raw:
Innorack Tall IVC Rat

A highly controlled clean environment at each cage level

It’s portable, ergonomic, and easy to configure top-of-the-line ventilated rat housing system designed to house Innovive disposable IVC cages. The rack is powered by patented transversal airflow and delivers dual HEPA-filtered air into each recyclable cage. Controlled airflow allows positive and negative modes of operation. It comes with a dynamic digital controller and provides a high-quality environment for your animals. Contact Sales FEATURES

Innorack Tall IVC Rat Features

  • Dynamic Digital Controller
  • • Dynamically maintains settings on both supply and exhaust blowers.
  • • Quick-look color display for easy status monitoring.
  • Ergonomic Design
  • • Lightweight rack & blowers.
  • • Full cage visibility.
  • Easy Cleaning and Maintenance
  • • Continuous shelf design and smooth beveled surface allow for easy cleaning.
  • • Quick-disconnect blowers.
  • • Autoclavable Innorack available upon request.
  • Low-Vibration RackOperations
  • • A low-vibration ventilation system creates a stress-free animal environment, contributing to animal welfare.
MOUSE ENRICHMENT

Product Specifications

COMPATIBLE CAGING

Innocage® Tall IVC Rat

Tall rat housing solution with pre-bedded options Alpha-Dri Corn Cob Bio-Fresh Standard disposable rat cage bottom arrives irradiated and ready for use. Made of 100% PET plastic. BPA-free.
  • Features:
  • • Flexible, standardized, research-ready caging.
  • • Patented lightweight caging.
  • • 14-day cage changes.
  • • Completely disposable end-to-end solution.
  • • Closed-loop recycling services available.
